name: p2-public-llm-adaptive-20260912
objective: Improve the public-greedy submission while complying with the CaseVO LLM decision requirement.

primary_comparison.control: B1 full scan, public API only
primary_comparison.candidate: public greedy full scan, public terminal structure screen

llm_contract_arm.name: public_greedy_llm_mock
llm_contract_arm.purpose: Check complete CaseVO-compatible decision protocol and call budget; mock ranking is not an LLM quality estimate.
llm_contract_arm.model_choices: one schema-valid candidate per scan and intervention
llm_contract_arm.fail_closed: timeout, malformed output and exhausted quota select a validated candidate

adaptive_scan_screen.name: public_adaptive_scan_80pct
adaptive_scan_screen.decision_point: after 80 percent of node IDs have been scanned
adaptive_scan_screen.early_stop_condition: observed violent-negative share below 0.30 and public positive-graph gate open
adaptive_scan_screen.promotion_rule: require nonnegative family-level paired deltas and zero action failures on both independent and existing topology blocks

interpretation_limit: Local terminal scores and public custom-seed sandbox scores cannot establish the hidden leaderboard score above 900.
